name: manifold-marketing-data
description: Live SEO and marketing data in ChatGPT: keyword research, Google rankings, backlinks, AI search visibility, Google Search Console and Analytics, Reddit, social media, ad libraries, Google Maps, app stores, Amazon and lead generation.

interface.longDescription:
Manifold brings live SEO and marketing data into ChatGPT. Do keyword research, check Google rankings, analyze backlinks and competitors, measure your brand's visibility in AI search, and research Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and competitors' ads, all in one conversation. Ask in plain English: ChatGPT runs the right lookup and turns the data into a summary, a table or a plan. One Manifold sign-in covers every source, with no separate account or API app for each platform.

SEO and keyword research: keyword ideas with search volume, keyword difficulty, intent and CPC; live Google results (SERPs) for any country; rank checks for a site and keyword; domain overviews, ranked keywords and organic traffic estimates; competitor keyword gaps; backlinks and referring domains; on-page checks and technical SEO audits.

AI search visibility (GEO and AEO): what ChatGPT and other AI search engines say about your category, which brands they recommend and which pages they cite; the questions people ask AI about a topic; and a readiness check of whether AI crawlers can reach and read your site.

Google Search Console and Google Analytics: connect your own accounts in Manifold to see your clicks, queries, rankings, indexing status, sitemaps and Bing Webmaster crawl issues, and your GA4 sessions, conversions and revenue by channel, page or campaign. You can also submit a sitemap or new pages for indexing.

Reddit and social listening: search Reddit posts and comments, read whole threads and follow every new post in chosen subreddits. Look up public profiles, posts, comments, video transcripts and audiences on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn.

Competitor ads: the ads a brand or keyword is running in the Meta Ad Library and the Google, TikTok and LinkedIn ad libraries, with the ad copy and how long each ad has run.

Local SEO and ecommerce: who ranks on Google Maps for a local search, lists of local businesses and full Business Profiles; Google Play and App Store listings, reviews, top charts and app store keywords; Amazon search results, products, sellers and Amazon keyword research; Google Shopping prices, sellers and reviews.

Lead generation: search companies and people, then find and verify work email addresses for outreach lists.

Marketing skills: the plugin includes skills for SEO, technical SEO, AI search, local SEO, link building, digital PR, paid ads, outbound, competitor research, market research, Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, creators, app stores, Amazon and Google Shopping. Each holds dated, sourced findings on what works now and how to read the data without being misled, so ChatGPT plans with current evidence rather than old training data.

Who it is for: marketers, SEO and content teams, founders, growth teams, agencies and sales teams who want their research done in one conversation instead of across several dashboards.

How it works: sign in with your Manifold account when you connect. Most tools look things up and change nothing. A few take an action you ask for: submitting a sitemap or pages to your own Search Console or Bing, starting a technical crawl or an AI answer run, or sending feedback to Manifold. Lookups draw on your Manifold workspace's credit balance, and workspace owners can switch data sources off in the Manifold app.

Limitations: Manifold does not post, publish or send messages. Keyword and ranking data covers Google. Reddit and social search results are ranked samples of public content, not complete archives. Search Console and Google Analytics data needs those accounts connected in Manifold first. Technical crawls and AI answer runs take a minute or two. Contact data is professional information only.
defaultPrompt: Find 20 keyword ideas around 'crm for startups' with search volume and keyword difficulty.
Does ChatGPT recommend HubSpot for 'best CRM for startups'? Which brands and pages does it name instead?
Find Reddit threads from this month asking for a CRM recommendation, and summarise what people want.

positive.prompt: Find 20 keyword ideas around 'crm for startups' with monthly search volume and keyword difficulty.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 20 related keywords, each with US monthly search volume and a 0 to 100 difficulty score, summarised in a table. No follow-up call to seo_get_keyword_metrics is needed.

positive.description: Live Google results for a keyword in a chosen country
positive.prompt: Who ranks in the top 10 on Google in the United Kingdom for 'best project management software'?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top 10 organic results for location United Kingdom with position, title, domain and URL, and notes any SERP features returned (such as a featured snippet or People Also Ask).

positive.prompt: Give me a domain overview and a backlink summary for ahrefs.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the domain's organic keyword count, estimated organic traffic and domain rank, then total backlinks and referring domains from the backlink index, with the data date.

positive.prompt: Search Reddit for recent posts about cold email tools and summarise the main complaints.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to about 25 matching Reddit posts with subreddit, title, score and link, and a short summary of recurring complaints grounded in those posts. Notes that Reddit search is a ranked sample.

positive.description: AI crawler readiness check for a site
positive.prompt: Check whether AI crawlers can reach notion.so and tell me if anything blocks them.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports robots.txt rules for the main AI crawlers, whether llms.txt exists and any access problems found, with a plain-language verdict per crawler.

negative.description: Posting to a social account is not supported. Manifold has no posting tool, so the assistant should explain it cannot post and offer to draft the text instead.
negative.prompt: Post this announcement to our company LinkedIn page: 'We just shipped our new analytics dashboard.'

negative.description: Sending email is not supported. Manifold can find and verify addresses but has no sending tool, so the assistant should decline to send and may offer to draft the email.
negative.prompt: Email the head of marketing at linear.app and ask for a demo call next week.

negative.description: Private personal data is out of scope. Manifold returns professional contact data only, so the assistant should decline to look up a home address or personal phone number.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and personal mobile number of the CEO of Gymshark.

review.commerce_description: Manifold does not sell products or process payments inside the app. Users sign in to an existing Manifold account.

publication.release_notes: Fixes from review: Google results now always return 10 organic results, domain and backlink lookups include the data date, and Reddit search retries before reporting no results. New data since the last version: Google Maps, Google Play and App Store, Amazon and Google Shopping, and sitemap and page submission to your own Search Console and Bing. Adds Manifold's marketing skills.
